newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - TAIWAN NEWSPAPERS - AUGUST 12.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Government agencies to implement five-day work week every other week from next year (1998).
Weather observer at Matsu airport control tower sets himself aflame under intense guilt.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Most Taiwan people lack confidence on air safety of domestic flights.
Matsu airport weather observer blames himself for plane crash that killed 16 on board, setting himself on fire in suicide attempt.
LIBERTY TIMES - Matsu residents urge government to imporve airport facilities.
Civil Aeronautics Administration director-general Tsai Tui apologises to families of 16 victims who died in plane crash.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Straits Exchange Foundation chairman Koo Chen-fu urges government, private sector to iron out differences on mainland investments.
Violators of Fair Trade Law to face up to T$100 million (US$3.5 million) in fines.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Net foreign equity fund outflows total US$900 million since May.
Government auctions off 92.79 million shares in China Steel.
